<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/product-prototype">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ProductPrototype" name="Product Prototype Development" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process" name="Start">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Identify</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyIdea" name="Identify a product idea or improvement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Identify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Identify_Research</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InitialResearch" name="Conduct initial research">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Identify_Research</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Research_Feasibility</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FeasibilityStudies" name="Conduct feasibility studies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Research_Feasibility</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Feasibility_Design</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftDesignConcepts" name="Draft design concepts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Feasibility_Design</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Design_Select</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectDesign" name="Select a promising design">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Design_Select</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Select_Build</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildPrototype" name="Build prototype using available materials and resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Select_Build</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Build_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestPrototype" name="Test functionality, safety, and market potential">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Build_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Refine_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Feedback</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectFeedback" name="Collect testing feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Feedback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Feedback_RefinementDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefinementDecision" name="Is refinement needed?" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Feedback_RefinementDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RefinementNeeded</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoRefinement</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefinePrototype" name="Refine prototype">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RefinementNeeded</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Refine_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrototypeOutcome" name="Prototype outcome?" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoRefinement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Outcome_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Outcome_Discarded</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Approved" name="Approved for further development">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Outcome_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Discarded" name="Discarded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Outcome_Discarded</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Identify" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Task_IdentifyIdea"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Identify_Research" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyIdea" targetRef="Task_InitialResearch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Research_Feasibility" sourceRef="Task_InitialResearch" targetRef="Task_FeasibilityStudies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feasibility_Design" sourceRef="Task_FeasibilityStudies" targetRef="Task_DraftDesignConcepts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Design_Select" sourceRef="Task_DraftDesignConcepts" targetRef="Task_SelectDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Build" sourceRef="Task_SelectDesign" targetRef="Task_BuildPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_Test" sourceRef="Task_BuildPrototype" targetRef="Task_TestPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Feedback" sourceRef="Task_TestPrototype" targetRef="Task_CollectFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_RefinementDecision" sourceRef="Task_CollectFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_RefinementDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefinementNeeded" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementDecision" targetRef="Task_RefinePrototype">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refinementNeeded = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoRefinement" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementDecision" targetRef="Gateway_PrototypeOutcome">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refinementNeeded = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refine_Test" sourceRef="Task_RefinePrototype" targetRef="Task_TestPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outcome_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_PrototypeOutcome" targetRef="EndEvent_Approved">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">prototypeApproved = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outcome_Discarded" name="Discarded" sourceRef="Gateway_PrototypeOutcome" targetRef="EndEvent_Discarded">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">prototypeApproved = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
